title: The Velvet Cricket Switchboard
description: On the Night of Borrowed Songs, a cricket plugs the meadow into its switchboard so each household can hear a neighbor’s tune.
alt: A green cricket in a burgundy waistcoat plugs a pink cord into a brass switchboard beside a window overlooking a moonlit meadow.
pairing: An imagined midnight holiday for exchanging songs × a telephone exchange operated by crickets
